signal: OLOID introduced Aura, an AI Identity Assurance Agent, in March 2026 and partnered with Ping Identity in May to bring passwordless verified trust to the clinical workforce.

email.body1:
Michael, saw OLOID introduced Aura, the AI Identity Assurance Agent, and partnered with Ping Identity to bring passwordless trust to the clinical workforce.

That product and partner momentum usually means more frontline-workforce accounts in play than BD can touch before they cool off. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for OLOID off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Michael, quick follow-up for OLOID.

As Aura and the Ping partnership drive interest, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to convert it, so the coverage gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings OLOID needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Michael, last bit of proof for OLOID.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other workforce-identity teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michael, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding BD headcount is not a priority while Aura and the Ping deal roll out, no problem at all. A product and partner push is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a workforce-identity motion? I will tailor it to OLOID either way.
